dataset: Flight-track distance benchmarks for the Gleason flat-disk map

source.attribution: Contains data from the adsb.lol open ADS-B archive; ODbL 1.0.

measurement.target: Observed flown-path length estimated by integrating measured ADS-B ground speed over elapsed time
measurement.method: Integrate step-interpolated path_gs values within each contiguous time-series sequence; do not bridge missing-data gaps.
measurement.units: ground speed in knots; elapsed time in seconds; nautical miles converted to kilometres using 1.852
explicitlyNotUsed: great-circle, spherical, ellipsoidal, or geodesic calculations
scheduled flight times or estimated cruise-speed averages
measurement.airportBoundaryUse: Airport airspace polygons, or a 20 km airport-centred fallback circle, are used only by the source API to identify flights departing and arriving at the selected airports. No airport or trajectory coordinates enter the track-distance integration.
